question: Which of the following rivers flows into the Bay of Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaveri**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Kaveri River flows into the Bay of Bengal: 
 
• Kaveri: Flows into the Bay of Bengal in the south of Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu 
 
• Other rivers that flow into the Bay of Bengal: The Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Ganga, and Brahmaputra also flow into the Bay of Bengal

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4207a814a4863a0e77501d56ed9167ff75bc68497f5721f28ad6d3ab041de9cd.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Bay of Bengal

 
• The northeastern part of the Indian Ocean.
 
• Bounded on the west and northwest by India, on the north by Bangladesh, and on the east by Myanmar and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands of India.
 
• Maximum Length: 2090km.

 Himalayan Rivers

 
• The rivers that originate from the Himalayan mountain ranges.
 
• These rivers are snow fed.
 
• They receive water from the melting ice of the glaciers as well as from the rains.
 
• The three main Himalayan Rivers are the Ganga, the Indus and the Brahmaputra.
 
• Narmada and Tapi: These rivers flow west, while the rivers that flow into the Bay of Bengal flow east 
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar groups of islands separate the Bay of Bengal from the Andaman Sea
